title: Ensure 'Allow Basic authentication' is set to 'Disabled' (WinRM Service)
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Remote Management (WinRM)\WinRM Service\Allow Basic authentication to 'Disabled'
reason: Basic authentication transmits credentials in plain text. An attacker able to capture packets could determine the credentials used for accessing remote hosts via WinRM.

title: Ensure 'Allow unencrypted traffic' is set to 'Disabled' (WinRM Service)
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Remote Management (WinRM)\WinRM Service\Allow unencrypted traffic to 'Disabled'
reason: Encrypting WinRM network traffic reduces the risk of an attacker viewing or modifying WinRM messages as they transit the network.
